usage: deskops add atom [-h] [--root ROOT] [--from-yaml FROM_YAML]
                        [--atom-type {atom.adr}] [--title TITLE]
                        [--five-wh-one-plus {what,why,how,how_not,when,where,for_whom}]
                        [--answer ANSWER] [--tags TAGS [TAGS ...]]
                        [--provenance PROVENANCE]
                        [--conversation-ref CONVERSATION_REF]
                        [--pointers POINTERS [POINTERS ...]]
                        [--status {accepted,superseded}]
                        [--decided-on DECIDED_ON] [--decided-by DECIDED_BY]
                        [--context CONTEXT] [--consequences CONSEQUENCES]
                        [--alternatives ALTERNATIVES]
                        [--supersedes SUPERSEDES [SUPERSEDES ...]]
                        [--partial-supersedes PARTIAL_SUPERSEDES [PARTIAL_SUPERSEDES ...]]
                        [--superseded-section SUPERSEDED_SECTION]
                        [--references REFERENCES [REFERENCES ...]]

Create an atom artifact.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT           Target repository root.
  --from-yaml FROM_YAML
                        Load the atom payload from a YAML file.
  --atom-type {atom.adr}
                        Create a typed atom: its model adds the fields of the
                        type (atom.adr: decided-on, decided-by, context,
                        consequences, alternatives, supersedes, partial-
                        supersedes, superseded-section, references, status).
  --title TITLE         Short, descriptive title for the atomic knowledge
                        unit.
  --five-wh-one-plus {what,why,how,how_not,when,where,for_whom}
                        The single 5WH1+ question this atom answers: one of
                        what, why, how, how_not, when, where, for_whom.
  --answer ANSWER       The curated raw answer to the selected 5WH1+ question,
                        written as one stable knowledge unit.
  --tags TAGS [TAGS ...]
                        Namespaced semantic tags used for retrieval and
                        grouping, each in the form namespace:value (e.g.
                        system:deskops, topic:templates). Tags do not encode
                        lifecycle, relations, evidence, or materialization.
  --provenance PROVENANCE
                        Optional URL or path to the authoritative source of
                        this atom's knowledge. Used for traceability and
                        provenance tracking.
  --conversation-ref CONVERSATION_REF, --conv CONVERSATION_REF
                        Optional conversation reference in the form
                        "<thread>/<message id>" or just "<thread>" (e.g.
                        "#acuerdos-sldb1/1234"); empty is not written.
  --pointers POINTERS [POINTERS ...]
                        Where this applies, as pointers with a class prefix:
                        'doc:<Model>:<id>', 'tag:<namespace>:<value>' or
                        'code:<path>::<qualified_name>'. Optional; the free-
                        text where/files stay as they are.
  --status {accepted,superseded}
                        'accepted' while in force; 'superseded' once an
                        accepted ADR replaces it in full.
  --decided-on DECIDED_ON
                        Date of the decision, YYYY-MM-DD.
  --decided-by DECIDED_BY
                        Who made the decision (the owner who disposes the
                        receipt).
  --context CONTEXT     The forces and the situation that made the decision
                        necessary.
  --consequences CONSEQUENCES
                        What the decision makes easier, harder or impossible.
  --alternatives ALTERNATIVES
                        Optional: what was considered and discarded.
  --supersedes SUPERSEDES [SUPERSEDES ...]
                        Ids of the ADRs this one replaces in full; each
                        becomes 'superseded'.
  --partial-supersedes PARTIAL_SUPERSEDES [PARTIAL_SUPERSEDES ...]
                        Ids of the ADRs this one replaces only in a section;
                        each stays 'accepted'.
  --superseded-section SUPERSEDED_SECTION
                        With partial_supersedes: the section of the earlier
                        ADR this one replaces.
  --references REFERENCES [REFERENCES ...]
                        What the decision applies to: files, documents,
                        repositories or tasks.

Example:
  deskops add atom --root . --title "Example" --five-wh-one-plus "what" --answer "..."
